screens.name: Login/Registration Screen
screens.purpose: Allow users to create accounts and authenticate

key_components.name: Email Input Field
key_components.interaction: User enters university email address

key_components.name: Password Input Field
key_components.interaction: User enters password with visibility toggle

key_components.name: Login Button
key_components.interaction: Submits credentials and authenticates user against users table

key_components.name: Register Tab
key_components.interaction: Switches to registration form with additional fields (first_name, last_name, major, year)

key_components.name: Forgot Password Link
key_components.interaction: Navigates to password reset flow

screens.name: Dashboard Screen
screens.purpose: Display personalized overview of user's notes, groups, and recent activity

key_components.name: My Notes Section
key_components.interaction: Displays notes from notes table where user_id matches current user, click to view/edit

key_components.name: My Groups Section
key_components.interaction: Shows groups from group_members table where user_id matches, click to open group

key_components.name: Recent Activity Feed
key_components.interaction: Displays recent downloads, uploads, and posts from downloads, notes, and posts tables

key_components.name: Upload Note Button
key_components.interaction: Opens note upload modal

key_components.name: Navigation Menu
key_components.interaction: Links to Dashboard, Browse Notes, My Groups, Profile, Notifications

key_components.name: Notification Bell
key_components.interaction: Shows unread count from notifications table, opens notification dropdown

screens.name: Browse Notes Screen
screens.purpose: Allow users to search, filter, and discover notes shared by others

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.interaction: Queries notes table by title, course_name, and associated tags

key_components.name: Filter Panel
key_components.interaction: Filters by course, tags from tags table, rating range, and date

key_components.name: Sort Dropdown
key_components.interaction: Sorts results by date, download_count, or average_rating

key_components.name: Note Cards Grid
key_components.interaction: Displays notes with title, course_name, average_rating, download_count, click to view details

key_components.name: Pagination Controls
key_components.interaction: Navigate through search results

screens.name: Note Detail Screen
screens.purpose: Display full information about a note and allow download and rating

key_components.name: Note Information Panel
key_components.interaction: Shows title, description, course_name, author from users table, upload date from notes table

key_components.name: Tags Display
key_components.interaction: Shows tags from note_tags and tags tables, clickable to search by tag

key_components.name: Download Button
key_components.interaction: Downloads file from file_url, creates entry in downloads table, increments download_count

key_components.name: Preview Panel
key_components.interaction: Shows preview of note content

key_components.name: Rating Section
key_components.interaction: Allows user to rate (1-5) and review, saves to ratings table, updates average_rating

key_components.name: Reviews List
key_components.interaction: Displays existing ratings and reviews from ratings table with user info

screens.name: Upload Note Screen
screens.purpose: Allow users to upload new study notes with metadata

key_components.name: Title Input
key_components.interaction: User enters note title

key_components.name: Description Input
key_components.interaction: User enters note description

key_components.name: Course Input
key_components.interaction: User enters or selects course_name

key_components.name: File Upload
key_components.interaction: User selects PDF, DOCX, or TXT file (max 10MB), uploads to storage, saves file_url

key_components.name: Tags Input
key_components.interaction: User adds tags, creates entries in tags and note_tags tables

key_components.name: Submit Button
key_components.interaction: Creates new entry in notes table with user_id, file metadata

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.interaction: Returns to previous screen without saving

screens.name: My Groups Screen
screens.purpose: Display all groups user is a member of and allow group creation

key_components.name: Groups List
key_components.interaction: Shows groups from group_members table where user_id matches, displays group_name, course_name, member_count

key_components.name: Create Group Button
key_components.interaction: Opens create group modal

key_components.name: Search Groups
key_components.interaction: Searches public groups from groups table where is_private = false

key_components.name: Group Card
key_components.interaction: Click to open group detail, shows role from group_members table

screens.name: Create Group Screen
screens.purpose: Allow users to create new study groups

key_components.name: Group Name Input
key_components.interaction: User enters group_name

key_components.name: Description Input
key_components.interaction: User enters group description

key_components.name: Course Input
key_components.interaction: User enters course_name

key_components.name: Privacy Toggle
key_components.interaction: Sets is_private field in groups table

key_components.name: Create Button
key_components.interaction: Creates entry in groups table with creator_id, creates membership in group_members with role='admin'

screens.name: Group Detail Screen
screens.purpose: Display group information, members, and discussion forum

key_components.name: Group Header
key_components.interaction: Shows group_name, description, course_name from groups table

key_components.name: Members Tab
key_components.interaction: Lists members from group_members joined with users table, shows role

key_components.name: Discussion Tab
key_components.interaction: Shows posts from posts table where group_id matches

key_components.name: New Post Button
key_components.interaction: Opens post creation form

key_components.name: Post List
key_components.interaction: Displays posts with content, user info, created_at, attachment_url if present

key_components.name: Reply Button
key_components.interaction: Creates post with parent_post_id set

key_components.name: Invite Member Button
key_components.interaction: Opens invite modal (visible only to admins based on group_members.role)

key_components.name: Leave Group Button
key_components.interaction: Removes entry from group_members table, decrements member_count

screens.name: Profile Screen
screens.purpose: Display and edit user profile information

key_components.name: Profile Picture
key_components.interaction: Displays profile_image_url from users table, allows upload

key_components.name: Name Display
key_components.interaction: Shows first_name and last_name from users table

key_components.name: Email Display
key_components.interaction: Shows email from users table (read-only)

key_components.name: Major Input
key_components.interaction: Editable field for major in users table

key_components.name: Year Input
key_components.interaction: Editable field for year in users table

key_components.name: Bio Input
key_components.interaction: Editable field for bio in users table

key_components.name: Save Button
key_components.interaction: Updates users table with modified fields, sets updated_at

key_components.name: Statistics Panel
key_components.interaction: Shows count of uploaded notes, groups joined, notes downloaded from respective tables

screens.name: Notifications Screen
screens.purpose: Display all notifications and allow management

key_components.name: Notifications List
key_components.interaction: Shows all notifications from notifications table where user_id matches, ordered by created_at

key_components.name: Notification Item
key_components.interaction: Displays type, message, created_at, highlights if is_read = false

key_components.name: Mark as Read Button
key_components.interaction: Updates is_read to true in notifications table

key_components.name: Mark All Read Button
key_components.interaction: Updates all user's notifications to is_read = true

key_components.name: Filter Tabs
key_components.interaction: Filters notifications by type (all, groups, ratings, invites)

key_components.name: Notification Link
key_components.interaction: Navigates to referenced item using reference_id (group, note, etc.)
